en.headline: Director and firm plead guilty in HK$52.9m bottled water contract fraud
en.dek: Lui Tsz-chung and Xin Ding Xin Trade admitted submitting altered certificates to win a government contract supplying drinking water to civil servants.
body: The director of a mainland Chinese trading company and the firm itself pleaded guilty on Thursday to fraud charges linked to a HK$52.9 million contract to supply bottled water to Hong Kong government offices.

Lui Tsz-chung, 62, admitted seven charges including fraud after prosecutors said he submitted altered water quality test certificates to the Government Logistics Department between May and August last year. The documents falsely suggested the XinLe-brand water had been produced and vetted by Robust (Guangdong) Drinking Water.

Xin Ding Xin Trade had held a three-year contract to supply the water to offices on Hong Kong Island and some outlying islands. The arrangement came under scrutiny in August 2025 after civil servants raised concerns about product quality. The company later admitted related charges of supplying goods with a false trade description and operating a food import business without registration.
The case was adjourned for sentencing. Government investigators had earlier partially terminated the contract after determining the firm was no longer able to perform it as required.

zh.headline: 內地公司及董事承認政府瓶裝水合約詐騙 涉5290萬元
zh.dek: 雷子聰及鑫鼎鑫商貿承認向政府物流署提交經改動證書，以取得向公務員供應飲用水的合約。
body: 一間內地貿易公司董事及其公司周四在法庭承認詐騙等控罪，案件涉及一項價值5290萬元的政府瓶裝水供應合約。
62歲的雷子聰承認七項控罪，包括詐騙。控方指他於去年5月至8月期間，向政府物流署提交經改動的水質測試證書，令部門誤信鑫樂觀音山瓶裝水由樂百氏（廣東）飲用水生產及檢驗。
鑫鼎鑫商貿原持有三年合約，向香港島及部分離島的政府辦公室供應瓶裝水。有關安排於2025年8月因公務員對產品質素提出關注而曝光。公司其後承認供應虛假商品說明貨品及未註冊經營食物進口業務等控罪。
案件押後判刑。政府早前已因公司無法履行合約而部分終止有關安排。
